dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous geometric narrowing from the maximum lateral width at the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Margins are primarily smooth; there is a subtle asymmetrical outward curvature on the right lateral edge relative to the more linear left edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Bright mature white; characterized by high reflectance on the right side and a significant longitudinal shadow on the left side of the dorsal ridge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of a few isolated, low-contrast dark specks on the left side of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark transverse linear marking or notch is visible at the extreme posterior tip of the visible body.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast, dark circular aperture (blowhole) is clearly visible on the anterior dorsal surface.
